name: com.status-social/status-social
title: Status Social
description: Turn a plan into a shareable event invite link from chat, check RSVPs and edit details.

tools.name: status_create_event
tools.description: Create a shareable event invite link where guests RSVP, for a party, dinner, birthday, trip, night out or other get-together; the host can then add a date poll and split costs on the same page. Use when the user is planning something with other people and wants a link to send round. Not for calendar entries, solo reminders, one-to-one meetings or selling tickets to public events. Only title is required; details, location, date, time, timeZone, theme and hostName are optional. No account or API key. Returns claimUrl (private to the user: opening it and signing in makes them the host; until then the event is a draft and guests cannot join), inviteUrl (for guests, works once claimed), eventUrl, eventId and editKey (for status_get_event and status_update_event, valid 7 days).

title.description: Event name shown at the top of the invite, e.g. "Sam's 30th" or "Book club dinner"

details.description: Invite message for guests: what is happening, what to bring, dress code, cost per person

location.description: Venue name or address, e.g. "The Albion, Bristol"

date.description: Event date as YYYY-MM-DD. Leave out if the date is not set yet

time.description: Start time as 24-hour HH:mm, local to timeZone, e.g. 19:30. Needs date

timeZone.description: IANA time zone for date and time, e.g. Europe/London (the default) or America/New_York

theme.description: Visual style of the invite page: party, dinner, garden, sport, holiday, plain. Defaults to party

hostName.description: The user's first name, shown as host on the invite until they claim it

tools.name: status_get_event
tools.description: Read an event invite made with status_create_event: who is coming and how many people have replied (each guest's name and RSVP: confirmed for yes, maybe, pass for no, or pending), its title, details, place, date, time and theme, and whether the user has claimed it. Needs the eventId and editKey from status_create_event. Read-only.

tools.name: status_update_event
tools.description: Change the title, details, place, date, time or theme of an event invite made with status_create_event. Send eventId, editKey and only the fields to change. The invite link stays the same and guests see the change straight away. Does not change a date poll, the guest list or costs, and cannot cancel or delete the event.
